articles.title: Lift Out of Service at Derker Tram Stop
articles.excerpt: The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service, affecting access for passengers travelling towards and away from Manchester.
articles.content_html:
A lift at Derker tram stop is out of service until further notice. The issue was reported on 12 August 2026 at 8:14am.

Passengers travelling towards Manchester can access the Manchester-bound platform via a ramp from Cromford Street. Those travelling away from Manchester can use a ramp from Cromford Street and a track crossing to reach the Rochdale-bound platform.

Transport for Greater Manchester has apologised for any inconvenience caused by the disruption.

For more details, visit the Bee Network live travel alerts page.
